mapper.select: select clue.*, ctr.id as ctr_id, ctr.clue_id as ctr_clue_id, ctr.user_id as ctr_user_id, ctr.subject as ctr_subject, ctr.level as ctr_level, ctr.record as ctr_record, ctr.next_time as ctr_next_time, ctr.type as ctr_type, ctr.false_reason as ctr_false_reason, ctr.create_time as ctr_create_time, u.name as ctr_assign_name, owner.name as assignName from clue left outer join clue_track_record ctr on clue.id = ctr.clue_id left outer join user owner on clue.user_id = owner.id left outer join user u on ctr.user_id = u.id where clue.id = #{id} order by ctr.create_time desc
